text: In the kitchen, follow four example ingredients. The agent picks them up, carries them to the preparation surface, then moves them to the cooking vessel. The served meal appears after the sequence, as a transformation of those ingredients. Cooking requires perception, manipulation, heat control and safety; moving a hand near a pot does not prove that a recipe is solved. We therefore show a simplified functional sequence with compressed cooking. Temperature, nutrition and food safety are not modeled. Research robots have demonstrated specific preparations, but reliably cooking any meal in any home is a much broader assumption. We assign thirty-five active human minutes to this chore. This is a chosen reference for comparing scenarios, not a monetary cost or a measured robot speed.
